# Helm of Teleportation (`magic-items:helm-of-teleportation`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Rare | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

This helm has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Teleport from it. The helm regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
